# The appointments Omononushi made — and who is keeping them

The mistake is reading myths as entertainment. Omononushi's cycle reads more like a charter — each story assigning a duty the modern world still pays for.

## At a Glance

- **Temple:** Omononushi
- **Pantheon:** Japanese
- **Domain of influence:** Mountains, Deity of Miwa
- **Pattern seats:** 3
- **Sectors touched:** Society & Spirit · Energy & Natural World
- **Strongest seat:** Faith & Spiritual Organizations
- **Series:** The Resonance Files, No. 303 of 449

## The Cycle, Read Forward

### Faith & Spiritual Organizations — through *The Serpent Husband*

A beautiful woman named Ikutamayori was visited at night by a mysterious lover.  She became pregnant, and her parents asked her to identify him.

The atlas states the seat in one line: *The great thing lord of Miwa; one of the oldest kami cults in Japan.* The story above is the long version of the same sentence. The trade thinks it is optimizing a process. It is re-enacting a charter.

### Forestry, Conservation & Outdoor Industries — through *Oracle of the Land*

When the heavenly descendants sought to take possession of the land, Ōmononushi — identified here with Ōkuninushi — was consulted.  He declared that the land should be surrendered peacefully and withdrew to a hidden realm.

The atlas states the seat in one line: *The mountain kami of Miwa; the forested peak is his shrine and his body.* The story above is the long version of the same sentence. The trade thinks it is optimizing a process. It is re-enacting a charter.

### Agriculture, Food & Harvest — through *Worship without Image*

Ōmiwa Shrine is one of Japan's oldest shrines and has no honden (main hall) housing an image.  The mountain itself is the kami, and worship is directed toward its peak.

The atlas states the seat in one line: *The mountain deity of Miwa; upland rice and sacred earth answer to him.* The story above is the long version of the same sentence. The trade thinks it is optimizing a process. It is re-enacting a charter.

## The Theme That Runs the Cycle

Ōmononushi's mythology is preserved in strange, archaic tales of snakes, possession, and oracles.

## The Method, Stated Plainly

Skeptical? Good — the system is built for you. Every seat in this file carries its why-line and its weight, the full derivation is public at the [methodology page](/patterns/methodology/), and the challenge process is part of the design. Falsifiable is not a posture here; it is the mechanism.

## For the Ones Who Work There

If you work in faith & spiritual organizations, forestry, conservation & outdoor industries, or any trade this temple holds a seat in, this is the honest version of what a placement means: your industry beside the story it has been re-telling all along — on the temple floor itself, before an audience that came specifically to read it. The [patron tier](/omononushi/patron/) and the [advertising terms](/terms/advertising/) describe the mechanics; the resonance above describes the fit.
